findings.claim: Crucible found ONE real defect and it was FIXED (not just documented): _lookup's two namespace-dropping fallback tiers let 5 Labs nodes (labs::karma::1.0/2.0 -> nodes/lop/karma.json, labs::filecache::1.0/2.0 -> nodes/sop/filecache-.json, labs::wedge::1.0 -> nodes/top/wedge.json) borrow the NATIVE node's help page (different nodes: native karma=306 parms vs labs::karma::1.0=408). Fixed by refusing namespace-relaxed matches when a bare same-base sibling owns the page; each doc now records its 'match' tier. Docs joined 1003 -> 998 (exactly the 5 removed); the 2 benign Object/muscle relaxations + 109 version-relaxed joins preserved.

8 of 1305 VOP types do not instantiate in a throwaway matnet (context-global VOPs: furguideglobal, furguideoutput, furskinglobal, geometryvopglobal[::2.0], geometryvopoutput, volumevopglobal, vopforceglobal) -> MatchDefinitionError. Recorded honestly with instantiated:false + note; NOT hidden, NOT faked.

for_ruling.item: CATALOG SIZE: rag/catalog/h22.0.400/ is ~49MB / 2.5M insertions in one commit (Sop.json alone 14.8MB). The brief specifies plaintext <category>.json (not gzip/LFS), so it is committed as-is. Ruling wanted on whether the served-corpus refresh (K.5) should gzip or LFS these before ingest.

K.5 REFRESH is NOT done here (per crucible criterion: rag/ingest_ledger is SINGLE-WRITER R1; this leg wrote rag/catalog/ ONLY and never touched harness/ingest_ledger.* or the served corpus rag/{corpus,documentation,semantic_index}). Wiring this catalog into scout/knowledge_lookup retrieval is a separate ledger-writing leg for a human to gate.
for_ruling.why: R1 single-writer discipline; the substrate exists but is not yet served.

for_ruling.item: AUDIT COVERAGE: the spot-audit samples 20 types/domain (deterministic stride) per the brief's '20 nodes'. A tampered NON-sampled row would pass unnoticed. Not rigging (proven real gate on sampled rows), but a coverage ceiling; widen if a stronger guarantee is wanted.
for_ruling.why: the brief bounds the audit at 20/domain; stating the ceiling plainly.

for_ruling.item: blake2b SEMANTICS: each category file's blake2b is the binary parm-surface stamp computed by build_node_catalog BEFORE docs_join adds the annotation-layer 'doc' fields, so it is intentionally NOT a re-hash of the docs-enriched 'types'. dump_receipt.txt is named to dodge .gitignore's '_*.txt' rule (was _dump_log.txt).
for_ruling.why: a future reader re-hashing types-with-docs would see a mismatch; documenting the intended contract.
